criteria.text: Picture : deposited vehicles
Picture : vehicles in the truck
Are the vehicles correctly deposited ?
criteria.description:
Opportunity: The DOZ could be at a better place in the same spot
Point of concern: Vehicles are too close from one another
Minor nonconformity: Vehicles are not facing the street (not ready-to-go)
Major nonconformity: A vehicle is lying on the floor (just after being deposited) / A trap is not closed / A vehicle is not closed

criteria.text: Are the vehicles and/or batteries transported in good condition, so as not to be damaged, compliant with the Pony standards?
criteria.description:
Minor nonconformity: DP or Scooters are not fixed in the truck / Batteries are not stored in a box
Major nonconformity: DP / Scooters / Batteries are moving during the drip

criteria.text: Does the driver drive well ?
criteria.description:
Point of concern: The driver do not park well when doing tasks
Minor nonconformity: The driver do not drive safely (too fast / sharp angles)
Major nonconformity: The driver don't follow highway code (except phone use when stopped, not at traffic light)

criteria.text: Picture : Overall tidiness
Overall tidiness: Is the warehouse clean enough ?
criteria.description:
Point of concern: Warehouse is dusty / There are nails / screws on the floor.
Minor nonconformity: There are waste outside bins
Major nonconformity:There are cables on the floor / Some parts of the warehouse are not easy to access

criteria.text: Picture : Overall storage
Overall Storage Status: Is everything belonging to the right zone ?
criteria.description:
Point of concern: Zone signs are not in the right place
Minor nonconformity: There are objects that belongs to the same zone in differents areas.
Major nonconformity: Mecanics don’t know what is the status of each vehicule (dropped off / waiting for repair / in deployment) / They don’t put in application the zone concept.

criteria.text: Picture : Tools
Tools: Does every tool has its proper place with a tag in the workstation ?
criteria.description:
Opportunity: There are no sign for each tool
Point of concern: Some tools don’t have their own place on the workstation
Minor nonconformity: Most of the tools don’t have their own place on the workstation.

criteria.text: Picture : Screws and Bolts
Screws & Bolts: Are the screws & bolts well sort in different boxes ?
criteria.description:
Opportunity: There are no sign for each screws and bolts
Minor nonconformity: Some screws and bolts don’t have their own box / share a box
Major nonconformity: Most of the screws and bolts don’t have their own box / share a box.

criteria.text: Picture : Spare Parts
Spare Parts: Are the spare parts well sort in different boxes ?
criteria.description:
Opportunity: There are no sign for each spare part / Spare part are not storred according to there weigh (large weigh near the floor)
Point of concern: Some spare part don’t have their own box / share a box
Minor nonconformity: Most of the spare part don’t have their own box / share a box

criteria.text: Picture : Zones
Zones: Are the zone well respected following Pony's rules ?
criteria.description:
Opportunity: The warehouse could be better organized.
Point of concern: One element don’t belong to the right zone.
Minor nonconformity: Several elements don’t belong to the right zone.
Major nonconformity: Mechanics don’t put in application the zone concept.
